rules.quote: for limits and sizing, propose the change and a server check in Task 17's data capture
rules.rule: For limits and sizing changes, propose the change and a server check in Task 17's data capture.

rules.quote: rather than a local RED/GREEN
rules.rule: For limits and sizing changes, do not verify them with a local RED/GREEN test cycle.

rules.quote: Logic and security code still goes test-first.
rules.rule: Write logic and security code test-first.

rules.quote: or under a hostile bundle need a deliberate server check, not passive use.
rules.rule: For faults that only appear after weeks or under a hostile bundle, run a deliberate server check rather than relying on passive use.

rules.quote:
The user permits modifying
it freely; it is for reference, not use.
rules.rule: You may freely modify the Hermes reference install at ~/.hermes, since it is for reference rather than use.

rules.quote: Run code inside it with `hermes --run-module <module>`
rules.rule: To run code inside ~/.hermes, run `hermes --run-module <module>`, where the module file is in ~/.hermes/hermes-agent.

rules.quote: use `gtrash put <path>`
rules.rule: To delete a path under ~, use `gtrash put <path>` instead of `rm -rf`.

rules.quote: Write no Python in this repository
rules.rule: Do not write any Python code in this repository.

rules.quote: New scripts are TypeScript
rules.rule: Write new scripts in TypeScript.

rules.quote: `node:*` only
rules.rule: In new TypeScript scripts, import only Node.js built-in modules using the `node:` prefix.

rules.quote: bash only when TypeScript is impractical
rules.rule: Write a script in bash only when TypeScript is impractical.

rules.quote: Python runs only as upstream's code inside the image
rules.rule: Run Python only as upstream's own code inside the image, never as repository code.

rules.quote: reach for TypeScript first, even for probes run inside the image
rules.rule: Reach for TypeScript first, even for probes run inside the image.

rules.quote: inline the minimum into a shell heredoc
rules.rule: When only upstream's Python can answer a question, inline the minimum needed into a shell heredoc.

rules.quote: say why in a comment
rules.rule: When inlining Python into a shell heredoc, explain why in a comment.

rules.quote: Python tooling installed by mise (uv, yamllint) is fine
rules.rule: Python tooling installed by mise, such as uv or yamllint, is allowed.

rules.quote: trust it and `git log` after compaction
rules.rule: After context compaction, trust the progress.md ledger and the git log as the source of execution state.

rules.quote:
Resume at the first task without a
`Task N: complete` line
rules.rule: When resuming plan execution, start at the first task that has no `Task N: complete` line in the progress ledger.

rules.quote: Task 17 is human-in-the-loop
rules.rule: Do not carry out Task 17 steps on your own; they require the user to participate.

rules.quote: secrets typed by the user with `dotenvx set`
rules.rule: Have the user enter secrets themselves using `dotenvx set`, rather than entering them yourself.

rules.quote: run docker through `/tmp/dk`
rules.rule: Run docker commands through `/tmp/dk` until the shell has a fresh login that includes the docker group.

rules.quote: read the ledger before acting
rules.rule: Read the progress ledger before taking any action on this plan.

rules.quote: Brief every subagent with the ledger protocol in
rules.rule: When briefing any subagent, include the ledger protocol from docs/agents/subagent-ledger.md in the brief.

rules.quote: paste its "Brief to paste" block
rules.rule: When briefing a subagent with the ledger protocol, paste the "Brief to paste" block from docs/agents/subagent-ledger.md.

rules.quote:
with a run
dir under
rules.rule: When briefing a subagent with the ledger protocol, give it a run directory under ${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/agent-ledger/dorothy-hermes/<run>/.

rules.quote: create the run dir before spawning
rules.rule: Create the subagent's run directory before spawning the subagent.

rules.quote:
on an early stop, reduce
the ledger with the doc's `jq` recipe
rules.rule: When a subagent stops early, reduce its ledger using the jq recipe in docs/agents/subagent-ledger.md.

rules.quote:
relaunch fresh on uncovered items
rather than resuming the dead agent
rules.rule: After an early subagent stop, relaunch a fresh subagent on the uncovered items instead of resuming the dead agent.

rules.quote:
when a failure needs the owner to act wrongly, propose a
mechanical guard (ruleset, CI check, refusal in code) rather than dismissing
it.
rules.rule: When a failure requires the repo owner to act wrongly, propose a mechanical guard (such as a GitHub ruleset, CI check, or refusal in code) rather than dismissing the failure as out of scope.

rules.quote:
The user's own mistakes (e.g. committing a .gitignore to dorothy-memory)
belong in the threat model
rules.rule: Treat the user's own mistakes and negligence as part of the threat model rather than ruling them outside it.
